name: tomato-watch-party
description: Synchronized movie streaming platform with audience chat, throwing, and reactions

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,mobile -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:mobile
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../mobile && npm install
